text:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Provide a supported way to rerun failed positions**

When only some runs in a campaign fail, this recovery instruction cannot be followed by the planned CLI: the driver exposes `--runs` and `--output-file`, but no run-index, resume, append, or merge operation, so rerunning invokes a new sequence and overwrites or creates a separate file. Manually combining it would also violate the plan's no-hand-transcription rule and makes run-position pairing ambiguous. Either require rerunning the whole campaign leg or add a deterministic resume/merge mechanism.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
